title: Conflux authority-confinement and semantic-security documentation migration
constraints: Do not let model/classifier output narrow Principal Context or grant authority
Do not introduce endorsement as a Conflux mechanism
Do not edit historical archives or retained evidence
Planner output is not an authority source

canonical_terms.ACS_explicit: Persistent machine-readable organisational authority relation/PDP state
canonical_terms.D_e: Valid explicit scoped delegations applicable to execution e
canonical_terms.ACS_effective(e): Authority relation evaluated for execution e after composing ACS_explicit with D_e
canonical_terms.AuthorityEnvelope(e): Machine-enforceable effect set admitted by PC(e), ACS_effective(e), and authority-bearing operation/argument constraints
canonical_terms.SemanticJudgement: Human/model decision about appropriateness inside available authority; empirical rather than ITES-guaranteed

phases.name: Canonical ADR
actions: Record supersession of ADR-024 endorsement/trusted-transformation direction

phases.name: Normative semantics
acceptance: Defines semantic judgement and authority envelope
Recognises model-level security as empirical security

phases.name: Planning and delegation reconciliation
acceptance: Delegation requires explicit authorised principal action
Maximality remains scoped to fixed represented authority

stop_conditions: A code/runtime change appears necessary to make documentation truthful: report it instead of silently broadening this task
An ambiguity arises about whether a user statement counts as explicit delegation: do not invent a rule; request clarification
Repository conventions prohibit editing an accepted ADR: create a superseding ADR and link it
A publication file is marked immutable/archived: do not edit it
